L3 Unfilmed White Phosphor PVS-14 – High FOM:

FOM: 2376 min FOM.

Spot Spec: This option is manufactured with L3 aviation grade tubes. This is the strictest spot spec available from L3Harris. These tubes do not have any spots >.003″ in zone 1 or zone 2. Spots </= .003″ are acceptable.

These units are hand selected for the absolute best image quality and spot spec.

Ops-Core FAST Bump Helmet
FAST Bump high-cut helmet system is primarily designed for use in training operations where no ballistic threat is present. Offering protection from blunt force trauma, the FAST Bump has a shell weight of (size L) 1.02 lbs. offering a lighter alternative to the FAST line of ballistic helmets.

Wilcox J-Arm
The Wilcox Dovetail PVS-14 J-Arm features a dovetail interface shoe which provides a superior mounting solution to bayonet style J-Arms.

Wilcox G24 Mount
The Wilcox L4 G24 breakaway mount provides rock solid attachment for night vision goggles or j-arms with a dovetail interface. The Wilcox G24 mounts to any helmet using an Ops-Core VAS or standard Army shroud. The G24 mounting system allows the mount to break away from the shroud when stressed or sharp force is applied.

GWA NODs Vault
The GWA Nods Vault has quickly became the gold standard for night vision storage. This bag is the bag of all bags for storing and transporting your high end night vision devices. The GWA Nods Vault features a padded design with three customizable dividers, an inner storage compartment, mesh interior pockets, and a low pro carry handle.

Also Includes:

Sacrificial lens
Demist shield
Objective lens iris
